units.source_text: 妹尼僧得到了这样一个美人，觉得仿佛做梦，心中不胜欢喜，

en.t: The younger nun felt as if she were dreaming to have gained such a beautiful woman, and her heart was filled with joy,

units.source_text: 便强要她坐起来，亲自替她梳头。

en.t: so she insisted on making her sit up and personally combed her hair.

units.source_text: 浮舟病中全然不顾头发，只是把它束好了堆着。

en.t: During her illness, Ukifune had paid no attention to her hair at all, merely tying it up and piling it in place.

units.source_text: 然而一丝不乱，解开来一看，光彩艳艳，非常美好。

en.t: Yet not a strand was disordered, and when it was loosened, it shone brilliantly and was extraordinarily beautiful.

units.source_text: 这地方“百年缺一岁”的老女甚多，

en.t: In this place there were many old women who were, as the saying goes, one year short of a hundred,

units.source_text: 她们看看浮舟，觉得容光眩目，好比天上降下来的仙子，只怕她插翅飞去呢。

en.t: and when they looked at Ukifune, they found her radiance dazzling, like a fairy descended from heaven, and feared she might sprout wings and fly away.

units.source_text: 她们对她说道：“你为什么只管愁眉不展？

en.t: They said to her, "Why do you keep looking so sad and troubled?

units.source_text: 我们大家如此疼爱你，你为什么总是不肯亲近我们呢？

en.t: We all cherish you so much, so why do you always refuse to grow close to us?

units.source_text: 你究竟是谁？

en.t: Who are you really?

units.source_text: 家住哪里？

en.t: Where is your home?

units.source_text: 为什么来到这个地方？”

en.t: Why did you come to this place?"

units.source_text: 她们定要问她。

en.t: They were determined to question her.

units.source_text: 浮舟觉得非常可耻，答道：“想必是在长期昏迷之中遗忘了一切吧，

en.t: Ukifune felt deeply ashamed and answered, "I must have forgotten everything during a long period of unconsciousness,

units.source_text: 从前的情况我竟记不起了。

en.t: for I cannot remember anything about what came before.

units.source_text: 所能隐约回忆的只有这一点：

en.t: The only thing I can faintly recall is this:

units.source_text: 我一心想要离去这人世，每天夕暮走到檐前来沉思怅望。

en.t: I longed only to leave this world, and every evening I would go out beneath the eaves, sunk in sorrowful thought.

units.source_text: 有一天，庭前一株大树背后走出一个人来，突然把我带走。

en.t: One day, someone came out from behind a large tree in the garden and suddenly carried me away.

units.source_text: 除此以外，连我自己是谁也记不起来了。”

en.t: Apart from that, I cannot even remember who I myself am."

units.source_text: 她说时神情非常可怜。

en.t: As she spoke, her expression was terribly pitiful.

units.source_text: 后来又说道：“务请勿使外人知道我还活着。

en.t: Later she added, "Please do not let outsiders know that I am still alive.

units.source_text: 如果有人知道了，非常麻烦。”

en.t: If anyone finds out, it will cause terrible trouble."

units.source_text: 说罢嘤嘤啜泣。

en.t: When she had said this, she began to sob softly.

units.source_text: 妹尼僧觉得过分盘问得紧，使她痛苦，便不再问了。

en.t: The younger nun felt that pressing her too hard with questions had caused her pain, so she asked no more.

units.source_text: 妹尼僧疼爱浮舟，比竹取翁疼爱赫映姬更甚，

en.t: The younger nun cherished Ukifune even more than the old bamboo cutter cherished Princess Kaguya,

units.source_text: 常恐她化阵青烟，从隙缝中消失了，因此很不安心。

en.t: and she was constantly uneasy, fearing that Ukifune might turn into a wisp of blue smoke and vanish through a crack.
